tasks.title: Write an email
tasks.prompt: Your neighborhood community centre is looking for volunteers to help organize a weekend event. Write an email to the community centre coordinator. In your email: explain why you are interested in volunteering, describe any relevant skills or experience you have, and ask two questions about what the role would involve.

tasks.title: Respond to survey questions
tasks.prompt: Some people believe that remote work improves quality of life, while others believe it makes work-life balance harder to maintain. Which viewpoint do you agree with more? Explain your opinion with reasons and examples.
